blurb.zh: 气门、产卵器、尾须、尾铗和螫针
blurb.en: Spiracles, ovipositor, cerci, forceps and sting
blurb.ms: Spirakel, ovipositor, serkus, penyepit dan sengat

text.zh: 腹部装着消化和生殖器官，由许多环节组成，通常没有脚。
text.en: The abdomen holds the digestive and reproductive organs. It is made of many ring-like segments and usually has no legs.
text.ms: Abdomen menempatkan organ pencernaan dan pembiakan. Ia terdiri daripada banyak ruas seperti cincin dan biasanya tiada kaki.

text.zh: 身体两侧有一排小孔叫{{t:spiracle}}，空气从这里进入体内的气管。昆虫用气门呼吸，不是用嘴。
text.en: Along each side is a row of small holes called {{t:spiracle|spiracles}}; air enters the breathing tubes through them. Insects breathe through spiracles, not through the mouth.
text.ms: Di sepanjang setiap sisi terdapat barisan lubang kecil dipanggil {{t:spiracle}}; udara masuk ke dalam salur pernafasan melaluinya. Serangga bernafas melalui spirakel, bukan melalui mulut.

heading.en: At the tip of the abdomen

items.zh: {{t:ovipositor}}：雌虫产卵用的管子，螽斯的又长又像刀
items.en: {{t:ovipositor}}: the female's egg-laying tube; long and blade-like in katydids
items.ms: {{t:ovipositor}}: tiub bertelur betina; panjang seperti bilah pada katidid

items.en: {{t:cercus|Cerci}}: a pair of slender tail-like feelers

items.zh: 尾铗：蠼螋腹末的一对钳子
items.en: Forceps: the earwig's pair of pincers
items.ms: Penyepit: sepasang sepit di hujung abdomen cocopet

items.zh: 攫握器：雄蜻蜓交配时抓住雌虫用
items.en: Claspers: male dragonflies hold the female with them
items.ms: Pengapit: pepatung jantan memegang betina dengannya

items.zh: 发音器：雄蝉腹部的鸣叫器官
items.en: Sound organs: in the abdomen of male cicadas
items.ms: Organ bunyi: dalam abdomen riang-riang jantan

text.zh: 看到腹末有一对钳子，几乎一定是蠼螋；看到一根长长的“刀”，多半是雌螽斯。
text.en: A pair of pincers at the tail almost always means an earwig; a long 'blade' usually means a female katydid.
text.ms: Sepasang sepit di hujung hampir pasti cocopet; 'bilah' panjang biasanya katidid betina.
